conceptZh: 玩具機器人兩隻手臂不一樣長，拉鞋子拔河，最後穿上鞋。
object: a boxy toy robot with mismatched arms and a pair of sneakers
morph: two tugging forces spring a shoe onto the foot and strokes into 穿
creativeAngle: 長手臂和短手臂和鞋子拔河，鞋子彈上腳，筆畫也彈進洞裡成字。
promptEn:
An 8-second animated clip on a warm orange-and-cream backdrop. Lead: a boxy toy robot assembled from mismatched parts, one arm noticeably longer than the other, with a single blue antenna. The finished glyph 穿 is a saturated deep violet, centered, about 70% of frame height.
0.0-1.6s: the robot holds up a bright sneaker with the short arm and tugs it toward his foot; the long arm swings uselessly past. First "穿" as the shoe's tongue flaps like a tongue sticking out.
1.6-3.2s: tug-of-war: the robot pulls the shoe, a mischievous shoelace pulls the other way; he stretches, the stroke pieces on both sides pull apart. Second "穿" lands as the lace twangs and the strokes spring together.
3.2-5.0s: the shoe shoots onto his foot with a boing, the roof of the glyph drops over, and the glyph 穿 stands complete.
5.0-8.0s: HOLD, glyph perfectly still. At "穿鞋" the robot sits and pulls a second sneaker onto his other foot with the long arm in one smooth move, taps both feet in a tiny dance, and his antenna spins a happy circle.
Audio: Off-screen voice, warm and friendly, clear Taiwanese Mandarin, slow and distinct, reading exactly "穿、穿、穿鞋" (ㄔㄨㄢ、ㄔㄨㄢ、ㄔㄨㄢ ㄒㄧㄝˊ) with clear tones: the character, a short pause, the character again, then the word once, and nothing after it. No subtitles or vocabulary text; the only text on screen is the single glyph 穿.
No other text, no watermark, no flashing, no real people.

meaning: to wear / put on; to pierce through
conceptZh: 玩具戰士揮泡棉劍揮太用力，把自己甩成彈跳球，在地板、牆壁、天花板和花生的頭上連環彈跳，每撞一下就「喀」地敲進一筆，最後跌坐在完成的「穿」字頂端，花生疊的衣服飛起來剛好套到他頭上，變成穿衣服。
object: a chunky toy warrior with a foam sword and round shield who swings so hard he launches himself into a ricocheting bounce chain, plus Peanut the raccoon carrying a wobbling tower of folded shirts
morph: each ricochet (floor, wall, ceiling, Peanut's head) clacks one stroke group of 穿 into place: roof 宀, then the two 八 legs, then the 牙 below; the final bounce drops the warrior perched on the roof peak as a flying shirt lands over his head
creativeAngle: 改用「彈跳連鎖」而非拔河：戰士的招牌缺點（揮太用力自轉）就是發射器，每次撞擊都是一筆落位的聲音節拍，六歲孩子不用聽也看得懂。花生的衣服塔同時是撞擊點和「穿衣服」的畫面答案，讓聽到的詞和看到的動作完全同步。
promptEn:
An 8-second 2D cartoon clip on a soft butter-yellow backdrop with a flat pale-orange floor line. Lead: a chunky toy warrior in a dented tin helmet, big round shield, floppy orange foam sword, puffed-out chest, zero skill. Sidekick: Peanut, a small cartoon raccoon carrying a wobbling tower of folded shirts taller than himself. The glyph 穿 forms in saturated deep violet, centered, about 70% of frame height, with clean margins.

0.0-1.5s: The warrior stands lower left, glaring at a loose heap of violet stroke-blocks in the center. He points his sword at them and plants his feet. Peanut shuffles in from the right under his shirt tower and salutes at nothing. The voice says the first "穿" as the warrior winds up his sword behind his back, far too far.

1.5-3.0s: He swings with everything he has, misses the heap entirely, spins twice like a top and rockets off the floor. BOING off the floor: the roof stroke 宀 of 穿 clacks into place at the top. BONK off the left wall: the two little legs 八 clack in under the roof. THUNK off the ceiling: he drops headfirst, helmet first. The second "穿" lands as these strokes snap tight with a crisp clack.

3.0-5.0s: Hold one frozen beat as Peanut looks up, salutes, and the warrior's shield slams onto his helmet of shirts. Big squash-and-stretch BONK. The shirt tower erupts upward, the last stroke-blocks fly out and clack into the 牙 at the bottom, and the full glyph 穿 stands complete. The warrior's final bounce drops him sitting on the very peak of the roof stroke, tiny as an ornament, eyes spinning, dizzy grin.

5.0-8.0s: HOLD, the glyph perfectly still and fully readable, nothing covering any stroke. The voice says "穿衣服" exactly as one falling red shirt lands over the warrior's head: he wriggles, his head pops out of the neck hole, sleeves flop, and he raises his sword in a proud wobbly pose on the peak. Peanut, flattened on the floor with one shirt on his head, finally salutes at the right moment.

Audio: an off-screen voice, warm and friendly, clear Taiwanese Mandarin, slow and distinct with clear tones, reading exactly "穿、穿、穿衣服" (ㄔㄨㄢ、ㄔㄨㄢ、ㄔㄨㄢ ㄧ ㄈㄨˊ): the character, a short pause, the character again, then the word once, and nothing after. Soft cartoon boing and clack sounds, quieter than the voice, no music louder than the voice. No subtitles, no vocabulary text; the only text on screen is the single glyph 穿. No other text, no watermark, no flashing, no real people.
